body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes missing AI agent HTTP endpoints by ensuring required core service fallbacks (notably `metadata`) are available before plugins `start()`, and by removing a shadowed `metadataService` reference that prevented agent route construction. This unblocks Studio’s agent selector by making `GET /api/v1/ai/agents` resolvable again.

**Changes:**
- Kernel: pre-inject “core” service fallbacks between Phase 1 (init) and Phase 2 (start) so `ctx.getService('metadata')` works during plugin `start()`.
- AI service: reuse the already-resolved `metadataService` to build and register agent routes (and log how many were added).
- Dispatcher: extract a `mountRouteOnServer()` helper and add a fallback to mount cached AI routes if the `ai:routes` hook fired before the dispatcher registered its listener.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/core/src/kernel.ts | Adds `preInjectCoreFallbacks()` and calls it before plugin `start()` to ensure core services are resolvable during Phase 2. |
| packages/services/service-ai/src/plugin.ts | Removes redundant metadata re-fetch and reliably appends agent routes when metadata is available. |
| packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts | Refactors AI route mounting into a helper and recovers cached AI routes for hook timing edge cases. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the 404 root cause(s) and the fix across kernel/AI/dispatcher layers. |

`routePath` keeps the hard-coded `/api/v1` prefix when `route.path` starts with `/api/v1`, which means `createDispatcherPlugin({ prefix: ... })` cannot remap AI routes to a non-default prefix (despite the plugin supporting a configurable `prefix`). Consider normalizing by stripping the default prefix from `route.path` and then prepending the configured `prefix`, or (better) emitting route definitions without a hard-coded version prefix so the dispatcher can apply `prefix` consistently.

The cached-route fallback repeats the same `/api/v1`-pinned `routePath` logic, so recovered AI routes will also ignore a non-default `prefix` configuration. If you update the main hook’s path normalization, mirror the same logic here to ensure recovered routes are mounted under the configured prefix.

This change fixes agent route registration by reusing the resolved `metadataService`, but there isn’t a test asserting that `AIServicePlugin.start()` includes the agent routes (e.g. `GET /api/v1/ai/agents`) in the `ai:routes` payload when a metadata service is present. Adding a unit test with a mock `metadata` service would prevent regressions of this exact bug.
